title: CodeChef: Fitness Tracker
description: Chef wants to become fit. His office is `x` km from his home. Chef goes to office 5 days a week (making one round-trip each day). Determine total km Chef travels in a week.
solution:
def fitness_distance(x: int) -> int:
    return 2 * x * 5
explanation: 5 days of round-trip (2 * x) totals 10 * x km in O(1) time.
